title: Pool and Spa Chemistry Balance
dataSources: Whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), sump pump (`sumppump:event`), well pump (`wellpump:event`), pool/spa chemistry (`pool:chemistry`), water softener (`watersoftener:status`), irrigation zones (`irrigation:zone`).
app: Smart water meters (Flume / Flo / HomeWizard), sump- and well-pump sensors, pool/spa controllers, water-softener and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pool:chemistry
| stats latest(ph) as ph, latest(orp_mv) as orp, latest(temp_c) as temp
| eval ph_ok=if(ph>=7.2 AND ph<=7.8,"good","adjust"), sanitiser_ok=if(orp>=650,"good","low")
description: Tracks pool or spa pH and sanitiser level so the water stays safe and comfortable without constant test strips.
value: Unbalanced pool water irritates skin and eyes and lets algae bloom; continuous chemistry keeps it safe with far less fuss.
implementation: Ingest a pool controller's pH and ORP readings; alert when either drifts out of the safe range.
visualization: Single-value panels for pH and sanitiser level with safe bands.
grandmaExplanation: It checks that your pool or hot tub water is balanced and safe to swim in, without endless testing.
